description: Get the approximate number of members in the client group.

operations.description: Returns the approximate number of members in the client group.

params.description: Resource group name within the specified subscriptionId.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: OMS workspace containing the resources of interest.
params.name: workspaceName

params.description: UTC date and time specifying the end time of an interval. When not specified the service uses DateTime.UtcNow
params.name: endTime

params.name: startTime

props.description: Number of members in the client group. Use this value together with the value of ```accuracy```. If accuracy is `exact` then the value represents the actual number of members in the cloud. When accuracy is `estimated`, the actual number of members is larger than the value of ```count```.
props.name: count
